note: v446: Per-section logo control. In Settings → Sections, tap an enabled section to expand its own settings — Invoices and Loan each get their own 'Show logo' toggle, so you can keep the logo on invoices but hide it on loan reports (or vice versa). The Appearance toggle now governs just the financial reports (P&L, Expense, Budget). New columns invoice_logo + loan_logo (default on; app works before the migration runs).
